name: Kailin Zhu
title: Staff Designer
bio: Kailin Zhu is a design lead and creative technologist exploring new forms of creative tools and immersive media. Currently at Adobe, Kailin leads the design of 0-to-1 spatial media creation tools that enable new ways to create spatial content with the power of AI. Previously, she worked at Unity Technologies and ustwo, designing consumer-facing platforms across XR, gaming, and interactive media, shaping how playful interactive experiences are created, scaled, and enjoyed by audiences worldwide. Kailin is also an independent game designer whose work has been showcased at E3, IndieCade, the Smithsonian American Art Museum, and SXSW.
